subject.title: fix: native Codex workers stall safely across parent turns

question: Should generic execution-receipt recording and gate evaluation become a supported shared `AgentHarnessTaskRuntime` plugin API, or should this supervision contract remain Codex-owned until another runtime needs it?
rationale: The branch adds three public task-runtime methods and a new persisted receipt model for a single bundled plugin; repository policy treats plugin SDK additions and persisted compatibility surfaces as maintainer-visible contract decisions.

options.title: Approve the shared receipt contract
options.body: Keep the generic SDK methods and SQLite receipt model, documenting that future detached runtimes may rely on the same machine-evidence gate.

options.title: Keep receipts Codex-owned for now
options.body: Move the Codex-specific receipt projection and gating behind an existing generic task seam, avoiding a new shared plugin API until a second owner demonstrates the abstraction.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared receipt contract
recommendation.body: Keep the generic SDK methods and SQLite receipt model, documenting that future detached runtimes may rely on the same machine-evidence gate.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the receipt and lifecycle implementation and has the most concrete evidence about the intended owner boundary.
